_instructions: Copy this file to candidate_profile.json and replace every placeholder below with your own details. This file holds the parts of your resume that DON'T change per job application (contact info, base skill list, work history, education). Only the summary and selected projects change per JD, and those are generated automatically by main.py.
tagline: Your Title | Core Skill 1 • Core Skill 2 • Core Skill 3
base_summary: A 2-3 sentence factual description of your experience level, core stack, and the kind of work you do. Used as grounding context so the AI-generated per-JD summary stays truthful instead of inventing things.

bullets: rest of the achievement with a concrete metric if possible.

education.school: Your School (GPA/CGPA if you want to include it)
